seal.statement: The partition CDC obligation lane ships every owed obligation after its scan cursor, up to the existing count bound and a byte bound, as one ordered vector in one durable wave: draining a backlog of B owed rows takes at most ceil(B / bound) waves plus one per byte-bound split instead of B waves, while order within the partition, exact occurrence identity, the acknowledgement rule (a row is delivered only by a committed CDC_DELIVERED proposed after every current leaf returned a committed receipt for a vector containing it) and the idempotent recipient effect are unchanged.

text:
Transition record and scope before any edit (contract-first checklist; base 9a22bf79b, rule-set revision 5; lead = takeover session 2026-11-14, writer = one implementation subagent, verifier = separate subagent). Design source: cdc-delivery-design-note-2026-11-11.md section 4 (Stage 1) on wip/formation-integration-20261111, direction endorsed by external review; its Stage 2/3 code is NOT imported (last verdict on that code REJECT, no physical proof). Cause measured on ed708dfd: see evidence/receipt.json. History: slot introduced 2026-10-23 (681da1dc1) as a memory/custody bound, lane page read reduced 256 -> 1 the same day to stop preloading payloads across awaits; batching on the durable path was never decided against; 15 slicing patches 10-27..11-08 tuned around the slot without measuring sender latency. Comparable systems (etcd/raft MsgApp batching and inflights, TiKV per-connection batching, Kafka fetch batching, PostgreSQL walsender) all batch per ordered stream and acknowledge by position.
1 Producer/consumer symbols: producer driveCdcObligations -> driveOnce -> drivePage/deliverObligation (becomes one vector per await) in src/partition/partition-cdc-obligation-delivery.js; progress cell in partition-cdc-obligation-progress.js; subscriber wrapper deliverCDCEventToSubscriber/buildCDCSubscriberWrapper in partition-cdc-delivery.js; buildPartitionCdcPropagationSubscriber; propagatePartitionCDCEvent (seed-runtime-bridge-owner, node-joining-publication-activation and their delegates); CDCGroupPropagationService.propagateCDCEvent/assertPropagationRequest -> propagateDurableCdcEvent (captureCdcEvents(options.events)); unchanged consumers source.applyCDCBatch / messageRouter.deliver -> applyDurableCdcBatch; the second durable subscriber (live-query, subscribeToCDCWithHandshake) takes the same vector contract.
2 Owner-defined shape: the vector is the existing frozen event array of captureCdcEvents, each member eventOf(obligation); the answer is the existing committed/provisional/unknown outcome over that vector; no new type.
3 Identity/generation: event (sourcePartition,eventKey,digest); vector cdcVectorDigest; lane leadership tenure; subscriber subscriptionEpoch; recipient groupId + observed route lifetime; receipt (groupId,logIndex,term). Unchanged; only the vector length differs.
4 Ordering: rows read ORDER BY log_index, ordinal; the vector preserves it; the recipient commits one entry and applies members in array order; vectors of one partition are sent one at a time (lane single-flight), so vector order is log order. No ordering claim across partitions (architecture: delivery has no global ordering).
5 Absent vs unavailable: no owed rows DRAINED; no subscribers NO_SUBSCRIBERS; recipient not committed cdc_committed_acceptance_unknown with deferRetry; not leader NOT_LEADER. Unchanged typed outcomes.
6 Durable commit: unchanged. Recipient group commit of the CDC batch makes the receipt; the source partition's commit of CDC_DELIVERED makes rows delivered.
7 Retained obligations: every row of an uncovered vector stays owed; a partially covered vector keeps covered leaves in the pinned cell (positions and digests only) and the retry presents the same vector; if the pinned range no longer reads back identically (rows acknowledged through hydration) the cell is discarded and rebuilt, re-delivery being idempotent; hydrated-prefix rows are acknowledged per row before any await exactly as today.
8 Wake/cleanup: unchanged wakes (committed entry, leader elected, handshake, retry timer, after flush); lane reset on tenure change discards the cell.
Writable paths: src/partition/partition-cdc-obligation-{constants,delivery,progress,lane}.js, src/partition/partition-cdc-delivery.js, src/bootstrap/shared/partition-cdc-propagation-subscriber.js, the propagatePartitionCDCEvent pass-throughs under src/bootstrap/**, src/topology/cdc-group-propagation-{service,durable-delivery}.js (request shape only), the live-query durable subscriber adapter under src/live-query/**, and the tests that pin the one-event call shape (design note 4.7) plus new reproducers R1-1..R1-5 (4.8). Excluded: ledger, CDC_DELIVERED, message-group files, cache, slot/slicing behaviour, recipient cursors, re-list, the partial-row cache writer, any timeout/bound value. Open counterexamples to witness: a vector containing several versions of one key applies in order (R1/O12); a hydrated prefix inside a page; an oversized single row; partial coverage then retry with identical digest; acknowledgement backpressure on the first row; a subscriber that is not the propagation subscriber.
